title: Refund Basis of a Price-Adjusted Line on a Changed-Mind Return
content:
**Northgate Store and Online Orders — changed-mind refund basis.** For a changed-mind Drive Up return of an electronics-class line of a Northgate Same-Day Delivery order, the refund basis follows the price adjustment standing on the line:

| Price adjustment standing on the line | Refund basis |
|---|---|
| a Northgate price drop adjustment | the adjusted unit price multiplied by the units returned |
| a competitor price match | the line's net amount less the amount of that match |
| none | the line's net amount |

**Hypothetical line of 2 units with a net amount of 300.00.** After a price drop to an adjusted unit price of 130.00, the basis is 260.00; after a competitor match that refunded 35.00, the basis is 265.00; with no adjustment, the basis is 300.00.
